description: Comprehensive reasoning vault for solving linear equations in one variable, including one-step, two-step, variables on both sides, distributive equations, fraction and decimal clearing, and applied linear modeling.

archetypes.name: One-Step Linear Equations via Addition and Subtraction Properties
archetypes.coreConcept: Isolate the variable by applying inverse operations to both sides of the equation: x + a = b implies x = b - a.
archetypes.mentalModel: Balanced scale pan: removing identical weights maintains equilibrium.
archetypes.governingRelation: x + a = b \iff x = b - a

archetypes.name: One-Step Linear Equations via Multiplication and Division Properties
archetypes.coreConcept: Isolate the variable with unit coefficient by dividing or multiplying both sides: ax = b implies x = b / a.
archetypes.mentalModel: Partitioning identical groups across the balance.

archetypes.name: Two-Step Linear Equations ax + b = c
archetypes.coreConcept: Undo operations in reverse order of operations: subtract constant term b first, then divide by coefficient a.
archetypes.mentalModel: Unwrapping nested layers: peel off additive outer layer before multiplicative core.

archetypes.name: Linear Equations with Variables on Both Sides ax + b = cx + d
archetypes.coreConcept: Collect all variable terms onto one side and all constant terms onto the opposite side: (a - c)x = d - b.
archetypes.mentalModel: Consolidating identical tokens to one side of the scale.
archetypes.governingRelation: ax + b = cx + d \iff (a - c)x = d - b

archetypes.name: Linear Equations with Grouping Symbols and Distributive Property
archetypes.coreConcept: Eliminate parentheses by distributing the multiplier to each term before isolating variables: a(x + b) = c implies ax + ab = c.
archetypes.mentalModel: Unboxing identical kits into individual components.

archetypes.name: Clearing Fractions in Linear Equations via LCD Multiplication
archetypes.coreConcept: Multiply every term on both sides by the least common denominator to convert rational coefficients to integers.
archetypes.mentalModel: Rescaling all measurements to a common denominator grid.

archetypes.name: Clearing Decimal Coefficients via Powers of Ten
archetypes.coreConcept: Multiply all terms by 10^k corresponding to the greatest number of decimal places to ensure exact integer arithmetic.
archetypes.mentalModel: Shifting currency units from dollars to exact cents.

archetypes.name: Solving Geometric and Physics Formulas for a Specified Variable
archetypes.coreConcept: Treat other variables as constants and isolate the target variable using standard balance operations.

archetypes.name: Applied Linear Break-Even and Cost-Revenue Synthesis
archetypes.coreConcept: Model commercial viability by equating total revenue to total fixed plus variable costs: P*x = F + V*x, yielding break-even volume x = F / (P - V).
archetypes.mentalModel: Intersecting linear trajectories of expenditure and income.
archetypes.governingRelation: P \cdot x = F + V \cdot x \implies x = \frac{F}{P - V}

archetypes.name: Uniform Motion Systems: Converging and Opposing Velocities
archetypes.coreConcept: Model collinear closing distance using combined rates: (r1 + r2)*t = D, yielding time to encounter t = D / (r1 + r2).
archetypes.mentalModel: Collapsing interval between opposing velocity vectors.
